purpose: Check supported swapchain statistics for moving-gameplay display observations without renderer hooks or another ETW search.
first_probe: Log GetLastPresentCount and GetFrameStatistics after Present. No DwmFlush or extra synchronization.
second_probe: Only if the first returns stale/zero statistics, try explicitly labeled DwmFlush synchronization to test the documented hardware-flip-queue caveat. This changes scheduling and cannot inherit baseline performance claims.
mapping: Map the returned PresentCount to a recorded successful GetLastPresentCount. Associate PresentRefreshCount with an observed SyncRefreshCount/SyncQPCTime anchor; exact anchor matches are preferred. Do not assume Present call count equals displayed frames, treat duplicate statistics as new frames, or label a refresh estimate as physical latency.
failure: Stop if results remain unsupported, zero or unmappable after the declared probes. Keep all HRESULTs, counters, source hashes and the working non-probe binary.
limits: Microsoft cautions that statistics can be unreliable with multiple monitors or other fullscreen applications. No physical input, scanout, panel-response or neural fidelity acceptance. Hardware/GPU processing remain unchanged.
